# AI Builds Navies — Parliament Issue Overrides
#
# Replaces vanilla port building parliament issues to construct
# wpdo_ clones and check for both vanilla and clone buildings.
#
# Generated by tools/calculate_maintenance.py

REPLACE:expand_docks = {
	estate = burghers_estate
	modifier_when_in_debate = { global_sailors_modifier = 0.5 }
	allow = {
		num_of_non_rural_ports > 0
		has_advance = dock_advance
		NOR = {
			has_advance = dry_dock_advance
			has_advance = shipyard_advance
			has_advance = grand_shipyard_advance
			has_advance = naval_base_advance
		}
	}
	chance = {
		add = 0.5
		add = { if = { limit = { navy_size_percentage <= 0.25 } value = 2 } }
		add = { if = { limit = { num_of_ports >= 10 } add = 2 } }
		multiply = { if = { limit = { navy_size_percentage <= 1 } value = 2 } else = { value = 1 } }
		multiply = { if = { limit = { num_of_ports < 1 } value = 0 } else = { value = 1 } }
	}
	on_debate_passed = {
		ordered_owned_location = {
			order_by = population
			max = { value = num_provinces multiply = 0.1 add = 1 }
			check_range_bounds = no
			limit = {
				NOR = {
					has_building = building_type:dock
					has_building = building_type:dry_dock
					has_building = building_type:shipyard
					has_building = building_type:grand_shipyard
					has_building = building_type:naval_base
					has_building = building_type:wpdo_dock
					has_building = building_type:wpdo_dry_dock
					has_building = building_type:wpdo_shipyard
					has_building = building_type:wpdo_grand_shipyard
					has_building = building_type:wpdo_naval_base
				}
				is_coastal = yes
				OR = { location_rank = location_rank:town location_rank = location_rank:city }
			}
			construct_building = {
				building_type = building_type:wpdo_dock
				cost_multiplier = 0.5
				cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_parliament_issue"
			}
		}
	}
	on_debate_failed = { parliament_debate_failed_effect = yes }
}
